The '''Kandarin Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and near the northern part of [[Kandarin]], such as [[Seers' Village]], [[Catherby]], and the [[Barbarian Outpost]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[The 'Wedge']] outside the entrance to [[Camelot]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Kandarin" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Catch a [[Raw mackerel|Mackerel]] at [[Catherby]].
|
*{{SCP|Fishing|16|link=y}}
*[[Big fishing net]]
|-
|2. Buy a [[candle]] from the [[Candle Shop|Chandler]] in [[Catherby]].
|
*3 [[coins]]
|-
|3. Collect five [[Flax]] from the [[Flax_field#Seers'_Village|Seers' flax fields]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|4. Play the [[Church organ|Organ]] in [[Seers' Village church|Seers' church]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|5. Plant some [[Jute seed]]s in the [[patch]] north of [[McGrubor's Wood]].
''Note: This is the [[farming patch]] next to [[Rhonen]].''
|
*{{SCP|Farming|13|link=y}}
*3 [[jute seed]]s, [[rake]], and a [[seed dibber]]
|-
|6. Have [[Galahad]] make you a [[cup of tea]].
|{{NA|None}}

|7. Defeat one of each [[elemental]] in the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|workshop]].
''Note: These are the [[Earth elemental|earth]], [[Water elemental|water]], [[Air elemental|air]], and [[fire elemental]] found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|workshop]]. Only the roaming earth elementals count.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Elemental Workshop I]]
*[[Battered key]] and [[weaponry]]
|-
|8. Get a [[Fishbowl (pet)|pet fish]] from [[Harry's Fishing Shop|Harry]] in [[Catherby]].
''Note: You have to talk to [[Harry]] with all required items in your inventory.''
|
*[[Fishbowl#Water|Fishbowl with water]]{{efn|[[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] require either 42 [[Crafting]] or completion of [[Skippy and the Mogres]] with 32 [[Slayer]] for a [[fishbowl]].}}, [[seaweed]], and 10 [[coins]]
|-
|9. Buy a [[Stew]] from the [[Forester's Arms|Seers' pub]].
|
*20 [[coins]]
|-
|10. Speak to [[Sherlock]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|11. Cross the [[Log balance (Coal Trucks)|Coal truck log shortcut]].
''Note: You can take a [[pickaxe]] to mine [[coal]] here to complete a [[#Medium|medium task]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|20|link=y}}
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Kandarin headgear 1]]:
**Acts as a [[light source]] when worn or held in the inventory
**While worn, gain double [[logs]] from [[regular tree]]s (no additional experience granted)
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*[[Coal trucks]] can hold up to 140 [[coal]], up from 120
*The [[flax keeper]] will offer you 30 [[Bank note|noted]] [[bow string]]s every day for 30 noted [[flax]], for a profit of {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Bow string}}-{{GEP|Flax}})*30}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*5% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course]]

|-
|14. Mine some [[coal]] near the [[coal trucks]].
|
*{{SCP|Mining|30|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Kandarin headgear 2]]:
**No new benefits
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*[[Coal trucks]] can hold up to 280 [[coal]], up from 140
*The [[flax keeper]] will offer you 60 [[Bank note|noted]] [[bow string]]s every day for 60 noted [[flax]], for a profit of {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Bow string}}-{{GEP|Flax}})*60}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*10% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course]], up from 5%
*10% increased experience from cutting [[maple tree]]s in [[Seers' Village]] (stacks with the [[Lumberjack outfit]])
*5% increased chance to save a [[Farming#Variable crop yield|"harvest life"]] at the [[herb patch]] in [[Catherby]], slightly increasing your harvest yield
*The [[spinning wheel]] in [[Seers' Village]] spins 33% faster
*[[Rope (Baxtorian Falls)|Ropes]] are now permanently secured at the [[Baxtorian Falls]] (with the completion of [[Waterfall Quest]])

{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Kandarin" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task

|1. Catch a [[Leaping Sturgeon]].

*[[Barbarian rod]] and suitable bait ([[fishing bait]], [[feather]]s, [[fish offcuts]], [[roe]], or [[caviar]])

|2. Complete a lap of the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course|Seers' Village agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|60|link=y}}
|-
|3. Create a [[Yew Longbow]] from scratch around [[Seers' Village]].
''Note: This requires chopping a [[yew tree]] in the village, cutting the [[yew logs]] into a [[yew longbow (u)]], then finishing it with a [[bow string]]. Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Fletching|70|link=y}} and {{SCP|Woodcutting|60|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]], [[bow string]] (can be spun from [[flax]]), and a [[knife]]
|-
|4. Enter the [[Seers' Village courthouse]] with [[piety]] turned on.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[King's Ransom]] and the [[Knight Waves Training Grounds]]
*{{SCP|Prayer|70|link=y}} and {{SCP|Defence|70|link=y}} (neither [[Temporary skill boost|boostable]])
|-
|5. Charge a [[Water Orb]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|56|link=y}}
*[[Dusty key]] or {{SCP|Agility|70|link=y}}
*[[Unpowered orb]] and means to cast [[Charge Water Orb]] ({{RuneReq|Cosmic=3|Water=30}})
*Protection from [[dragonfire]] recommended
|-
|6. Burn some [[Maple logs]] with a bow in [[Seers' Village]].
|
*Access to [[Barbarian Firemaking]]
*{{SCP|Firemaking|65|link=y}}
*[[Maple logs]], and any [[bow]] (except the [[Twisted bow|twisted]], [[Cursed goblin bow|cursed]], [[Dark bow|dark]], [[Crystal bow|crystal]], [[ogre bow|ogre]], [[Rain bow|rain]], [[Starter bow|starter]] or [[signed oak bow]])
|-
|7. Kill a [[Shadow Hound]] in the [[Shadow dungeon]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Desert Treasure I]]
*{{SCP|Thieving|53|link=y}}
*[[Ring of visibility]] (or a [[ring of shadows]]) and [[weapon]]ry
|-
|8. Kill a [[Mithril Dragon]].
''Note: The mithril dragon fought during [[Dragon Slayer II]] does not count for this task.''
|
*Access to [[Barbarian Firemaking]]
*[[Weaponry]] and protection from [[dragonfire]]
|-
|9. Purchase and equip a [[granite body]] from [[Barbarian Assault]].
''Note: This requires having defeated the [[Penance Queen]] at the end of [[Barbarian Assault]]. Buying and equipping the [[granite body]] counts as two separate steps, and completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.
|
*{{SCP|Strength|50|link=y}} and {{SCP|Defence|50|link=y}}
*See the [[Barbarian_Assault#Gameplay|gameplay overview]] and the [[Barbarian Assault/Strategies|strategy guide]]
*95,000 [[coins]] to purchase the [[granite body]]
|-
|10. Have the [[Estate agent|Seers' estate agent]] decorate your [[Player-owned house|house]] with [[Fancy Stone]].
''Note: You must finish the dialogue or the task will not count as completed.''
|
*{{SCP|Construction|50|link=y}} {{Boostable|n}}
*25,000 [[coins]]
*Additional 5,000 [[coins]] if already using [[Fancy Stone]], to change to something else and back
|-
|11. Smith an [[Adamant spear]] at [[Otto's Grotto]].
|
*Access to [[Barbarian Smithing]]
*{{SCP|Smithing|75|link=y}}
*[[Yew logs]], [[adamantite bar]], and a [[hammer]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Kandarin headgear 3]]:
**One daily teleport to [[Sherlock]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*[[Coal trucks]] can hold up to 308 [[coal]], up from 280
*The [[flax keeper]] will offer you 120 [[Bank note|noted]] [[bow string]]s every day for 120 noted [[flax]], for a profit of {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Bow string}}-{{GEP|Flax}})*120}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*15% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course]], up from 10%
*10% increased chance to save a [[Farming#Variable crop yield|"harvest life"]] at the [[herb patch]] in [[Catherby]], up from 5%
*25% discount on [[Thormac]]s' [[Mystic staff|enchanting]] services (requires completion of [[Scorpion Catcher]])
*10% more [[honour points]] from [[Barbarian Assault]]
*[[Camelot Teleport]] can now be used to teleport to [[Seers' Village bank]] instead
*10% increased chance to trigger the special effect of [[enchanted bolts]], even in [[PvP]] (stacks additively with other increases, such as that of the [[Armadyl crossbow]]'s special attack){{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1480491964260925444|date=10 January 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105529|archivedate=11 January 2022|quote=The diary reward adds an extra 10% of the base chance.}}

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Kandarin" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Read the [[Blackboard (Barbarian Assault)|Blackboard]] at [[Barbarian Assault]] after reaching level 5 in every role.

*See the [[Barbarian_Assault#Gameplay|gameplay overview]] and the [[Barbarian Assault/Strategies|strategy guide]]

|-
|5. Smith a [[Rune Hasta]] at [[Otto's Grotto]].
|
*Access to [[Barbarian Smithing]]
*{{SCP|Smithing|90|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
*[[Runite bar]], [[magic logs]], and a [[hammer]]
|-
|6. Construct a [[Pyre ship]] from [[Magic Logs]].
''Note: You must use [[chewed bones]] for the ship, not [[mangled bones]].''

|7. Teleport to [[Catherby]].
''Note: [[Tele Group Catherby]] will also work here.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]]
*{{SCP|Magic|87|link=y}}
*[[Lunar spellbook]] selected
*Means to cast [[Catherby Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Law=3|Astral=3|Water=10}})
|}
{{Notelist}}

*In ''RuneScape 3'', this diary is known as the ''Seers' Village achievement set'', which gives the reward of the [[rsw:Seer's headband|Seer's headband]].
